text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Curren-san. I'll be getting back late 
today.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san's birthday party? Curren wants 
to join in! Maybe bake a cake or 
something—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Enough of that, really. Just leave me 
alone. I'm only going to look at the 
starry sky."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Because today is special for me and my 
family... A starry sky that can only be 
seen once a year.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm. ...In that case, please take 
this hot cocoa with you♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I told you, I don't need anything—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Now, now♪ Spring nights get chilly! If you 
catch a cold on such an important day, 
your family will...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...The stars will be worried about you 
too, you know?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... ......Go easy on the sugar, 
please.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Understood! It's a birthday special, so 
I'll make sure to pack it with Curren's 
love too♪
